description: Low-level bridge to a freedesktop StatusNotifierItem (system tray icon) with a com.canonical.dbusmenu context menu, implemented in-process via GIO/GDBus. Contains no policy: background.js supplies icons, texts and menu items and reacts to events.

rgba.description: Base64 encoded, non-premultiplied RGBA pixel data (width * height * 4 bytes), as returned by CanvasRenderingContext2D.getImageData().

title.description: Application title shown by the tray host.

functions.name: create
functions.description: Export the tray icon on the session bus and register it with the StatusNotifierWatcher. Resolves to true if a tray host accepted the icon.

functions.name: setIcon
functions.description: Replace the icon pixmaps (several sizes may be supplied).

functions.name: destroy
functions.description: Remove the tray icon from the session bus.

events.name: onActivate
events.description: Primary activation (usually a left click) on the tray icon.

parameters.name: activationToken
parameters.description: xdg-activation token supplied by the tray host, or an empty string.

events.name: onSecondaryActivate
events.description: Secondary activation (usually a middle click) on the tray icon.

events.name: onAvailabilityChanged
events.description: Fired when the tray host (StatusNotifierWatcher) appears or disappears.
